provider: installed Codex App Server CLI on the authorized Windows host
backend: child-owned deterministic Fake X synthetic application
public_caller: public observe, generation-bound mint, then one direct guarded-input or one compiled guarded-caller route through RecordedPublicMcpCaller
model_input: exact PNG artifact returned by public observation
model_output: two-integer screenshot point; prompt includes no coordinate, alias, or action payload
task: select and click the visually labeled green tile
independent_effect: one owner-side XTEST button event at the model-selected point inside green rectangle changes independent application pixel to RGB [255,0,0]
independent_score: selected point equals retained owner click point inside target; exactly one click/effect; expected final pixel; selected route completed; verified neutral release; complete raw attempt ledger
trial_identity: one fresh session per cell; exactly one observation, model generation, mint, and selected action route
usage_agreement: App Server terminal usage, terminal RESULT.json, protocol journal and reconciled attempt ledger are checked; no independent upstream billing source is claimed
first_outcome_policy: retain all six first outcomes; no retries or replacements
reliability_scope: three paired samples; exploratory descriptive evidence only
